name: C Programming
short_description: Procedural programming, direct memory manipulation with pointers, and manual memory management.
description: Essential C programming covering pointers, arrays, memory allocation, struct layouts, file handling, and the C preprocessor.

courses.title: C Programming
courses.description: Structured programming, manual pointer arithmetic, and system memory management.

modules.title: Fundamentals
modules.description: C syntax, standard I/O (printf/scanf), primitive types, and compile pipeline.

topics.title: C Syntax & Compilation Stages
topics.summary: Preprocessor, compiler, assembler, and linker workflow.

topics.title: Data Types, Operators & Expressions
topics.summary: Integer and floating types, conversions, precedence, and evaluation rules.

modules.title: Operators
modules.description: Bitwise operations, arithmetic, relational, and logical evaluation.

topics.title: Bitwise Operators & Masks
topics.summary: Shifting, bit masking, and bitwise boolean manipulation.

modules.title: Control Flow
modules.description: If-else conditions, switch-case statements, for and while loops.

topics.title: Iteration & Switch Statements
topics.summary: Loop constructs, break, continue, and switch fall-through.

modules.title: Functions
modules.description: Pass-by-value, prototypes, static functions, and recursive stacks.

topics.title: Function Prototypes & Call Stack
topics.summary: Stack frames, function declarations, and return registers.

topics.title: Scope, Linkage & Storage Classes
topics.summary: Block and file scope, static and extern, and object lifetime.

modules.title: Arrays
modules.description: 1D and 2D arrays, contiguous storage, and bounds safety.

topics.title: Array Memory Layout & Indexing
topics.summary: Base address arithmetic and multi-dimensional row-major storage.

modules.title: Strings
modules.description: Null-terminated char buffers and string.h standard functions.

topics.title: Null-Terminated String Manipulation
topics.summary: strcpy, strlen, strcmp, and buffer overflow prevention.

modules.title: Pointers
modules.description: Memory addresses, pointer dereferencing, pointer arithmetic, and double pointers.

topics.title: Pointers & Address Arithmetic
topics.summary: The * and & operators, void pointers, and pointer offsets.

modules.title: Structures
modules.description: Struct declarations, padding/alignment, unions, and typedef.

topics.title: Struct Alignment & Member Access
topics.summary: Arrow -> vs dot . operators, memory padding, and unions.

topics.title: Unions, Enumerations & typedef
topics.summary: Overlapping storage, named integer constants, and type aliases.

modules.title: Dynamic Memory
modules.description: Heap allocation with malloc, calloc, realloc, and free.

topics.title: Heap Allocation & Memory Leaks
topics.summary: malloc/free lifecycle, dangling pointers, and memory sanitization.

topics.title: Linked Data Structures in C
topics.summary: Building a singly linked list and a stack with malloc and free.

modules.title: File Handling
modules.description: FILE stream pointers, fopen, fread, fwrite, and fclose.

topics.title: Binary & Text File Streams
topics.summary: Buffered I/O, EOF flags, and binary struct serialization.

modules.title: Preprocessor & Program Structure
modules.description: What happens before compilation, and how larger C programs are organised.

topics.title: Preprocessor, Macros & Multi-File Programs
topics.summary: #include, #define, conditional compilation, header guards, and separate compilation.

modules.title: Writing Robust C
modules.description: Avoiding the bugs C does not stop you from writing.

topics.title: Undefined Behavior & Common Bugs
topics.summary: Out-of-bounds access, uninitialised reads, overflow, and the tools that catch them.
